parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GTM instance.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the values of specific response parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: StrategyMode
parameters.description:
The access policy type. Valid values:

*   GEO: geographical location-based
*   LATENCY: latency-based

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns switch-dns-gtm-instance-strategy-mode --lang en --instance-id gtm-cn-cs02xyk4a00 --strategy-mode GEO --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns SwitchDnsGtmInstanceStrategyMode --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-cs02xyk4a00' --Lang en --StrategyMode GEO
